parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the toggle switches of the wall switch assembly, made of durable polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator for turning electrical circuits on or off by toggling between two positions.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rocks back and forth around a hinge or axis to make or break an electrical connection.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second toggle switch of the wall switch assembly, also made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional control point for a separate electrical circuit, functioning identically to the first switch.
parts.Movement_description: It rocks or pivots similarly to the first switch, allowing manual control of electrical flow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting plate of the wall switch, made of ABS plastic for strength and insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the switches and houses the internal wiring and electrical contacts.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or electrical box, serving as the mounting platform for the switches.
